title: Fixed Twin Open Grips and Radial Fruit Wedger
description: One newly authored complete fixed two-hand radial fruit-divider-style exterior. One thick continuous round outer rim connects eight full finite blunt radial plates to a central genuinely through-bored core ring. Eight actual open sector spaces remain between the plates. Two independently closed thick side grips have real open hand spaces and finite roots embedded in the outer rim. This whole flat radial divider with opposed open grips differs from the horizontal fork-shaft peeling machine and the single wheel in a long hand fork; no old geometry is reused or rescaled. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. No fruit, sharp edge, slicing or coring action, food fit, hand force, ergonomics, hygiene, manufacture or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
